# NESTRE

> NESTRE (Neuro-Strength) is a cognitive performance company. NESTRE turns cognitive
> performance data into personalized NeuroStrength Training, guided one-to-one by a
> NeuroTrainer. Founded in Orlando, Florida in 2018 by Dr. Tommy Shavers.

NESTRE helps people measure and train cognitive performance — the brain activity behind
how they focus, process, and respond. The method: capture a cognitive performance data
scan, interpret it with a human NeuroTrainer, then train with real-time neurofeedback.

## What NESTRE offers
- Cognitive performance data scan (EEG-based brain activity recording, ~3 minutes, ~0.5M data points)
- Mindset Profile — the human context behind the data
- Personalized NeuroStrength Training with a NeuroTrainer and real-time feedback
- The NESTRE App — daily cognitive workouts, mental framing (Frame It), Mindset Minutes, Mindset Music
